corrections.text: The article says "Two settings are now enabled by default: `spark.rdd.compress` and `spark.ui.contentSecurityPolicy.enabled`." The release notes list these two but are not limited to them: they also list `spark.kubernetes.executor.useDriverPodIP` enabled by default, whole-stage code generation for Union enabled by default, and a changed default of `spark.ui.xXssProtection` (to 0). The two named settings are examples, not a complete count.
